questions.question: If 28 May 2015 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 24 April 2023?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 28 May 2015 is Thursday, then the day on these dates will be:

28 May 2016 → Saturday

​28 May 2017 → Sunday

​28 May 2018 → Monday

​28 May 2019 → Tuesday

​28 May 2020 → Thursday

​28 May 2021 → Friday

​28 May 2022 → Saturday

​28 May 2023 → Sunday

Number of days between 24 April 2023 to ​28 May 2023 = (6 + 28) = 34

34 when divided by 7, leaves 6 as remainder.

Sunday - 6 = Monday

Therefore, it will be Monday on 28 May 2023.

Hence, ‘**Monday**’ is the correct answer.
